<file path="source.js">
const EventEmitter = require('events')
const NotificationMixin = { async send(payload) -> Promise<boolean>, _validatePayload(payload) -> boolean }

class BaseNotificationService extends EventEmitter:
    constructor(serviceName: string) {
        super();
        this.serviceName = serviceName;
        this._stats = {
            sent: 0,
            failed: 0,
            lastSent: null
        };
        this._isActive = true;
    }
    get stats() -> Object {
        return { ...this._stats };
    }
    get isActive() -> boolean {
        return this._isActive;
    }
    async send(payload: Object) -> Promise<boolean> {
        throw new Error('send() must be implemented by subclass');
    }
    async processNotification(payload: Object) -> Promise<boolean> {
        if (!this._isActive) {
            throw new Error('Service is not active');
        }

        try {
            this.emit('beforeSend', payload);

            if (!this._validatePayload(payload)) {
                throw new Error('Invalid payload');
            }

            const result = await this.send(payload);

            if (result) {
                this._stats.sent++;
                this._stats.lastSent = new Date();
                this.emit('sent', payload);
            } else {
                this._stats.failed++;
                this.emit('failed', payload);
            }

            return result;
        } catch (error) {
            this._stats.failed++;
            this.emit('error', error, payload);
            throw error;
        }
    }
    deactivate() {
        this._isActive = false;
        this.emit('deactivated');
    }
    activate() {
        this._isActive = true;
        this.emit('activated');
    }

class EmailNotificationService extends BaseNotificationService:
    constructor(config: Object = {}) {
        super('email');
        this._config = {
            smtp: config.smtp || 'localhost',
            port: config.port || 587,
            timeout: config.timeout || 5000,
            ...config
        };
        this._connectionPool = new Map();
    }
    async send(payload: Object) -> Promise<boolean> {
        const { recipient, message, subject = 'Notification' } = payload;

        // Simulate async email sending
        const connection = await this._getConnection();

        try {
            await this._sendEmail(connection, {
                to: recipient,
                subject,
                body: message
            });

            this._logEmailSent(recipient);
            return true;
        } catch (error) {
            this._logEmailError(recipient, error);
            return false;
        } finally {
            this._releaseConnection(connection);
        }
    }
    getActiveConnections() -> number {
        return this._connectionPool.size;
    }

class SMSNotificationService extends BaseNotificationService:
    constructor(provider: string = 'default') {
        super('sms');
        this._provider = provider;
        this._rateLimitQueue = [];
    }
    async send(payload: Object) -> Promise<boolean> {
        const { recipient, message } = payload;

        // Check rate limiting
        if (!this._checkRateLimit()) {
            throw new Error('Rate limit exceeded');
        }

        // Simulate SMS API call
        try {
            await this._sendSMS(recipient, message);
            return true;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`SMS failed: ${error.message}`);
            return false;
        }
    }
